sentences.en: So there's plenty to talk about.

sentences.en: Well, so let's start there.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那我们就从这里开始吧。

sentences.en: It's not exactly a secret that the rollout of many of the artificial intelligence systems over the past year and a half has been really bumpy.
sentences.zh: 过去一年半里，许多人工智能系统的推出过程非常坎坷，这并不是什么秘密。

sentences.en: We know that because one of them told you to leave your wife.

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 那是真的。

sentences.en: And you didn't.
sentences.zh: 但你没照做。

sentences.en: Still happily married.
sentences.zh: 依然婚姻幸福。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: To a human.
sentences.zh: 和一个人类。

sentences.en: Not Sydney, the chatbot.
sentences.zh: 而不是那个叫悉尼的聊天机器人。

sentences.en: And so, Kevin, tell us about the latest of these rollouts, this time from one of the biggest
sentences.zh: 那么，凯文，给我们讲讲最近的这些发布吧，这次来自其中一家最大的

sentences.en: companies, not just in artificial intelligence, but in the world, that, of course, being Google.
sentences.zh: 公司，不仅是在人工智能领域，而且是在全球范围内，当然就是谷歌。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, a couple weeks ago, Google came out with its newest line of AI models.
sentences.zh: 几周前，谷歌推出了其最新的AI模型系列。

sentences.en: It's actually several models, but they are called Gemini.
sentences.zh: 实际上是几个模型，但它们统称为Gemini。

sentences.en: And Gemini is what they call a multimodal AI model, which it can produce text.
sentences.zh: Gemini是他们所说的多模态AI模型，它可以生成文本。

sentences.en: It can produce images.
sentences.zh: 它可以生成图像。

sentences.en: And it appeared to be very impressive.
sentences.zh: 而且它看起来非常令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: Google said that it was sort of the state of the art, its most capable model ever.
sentences.zh: 谷歌称它是某种最先进的技术，是其有史以来能力最强的模型。

sentences.en: And Google has been under enormous pressure for the past year and a half or so, ever since
sentences.zh: 自ChatGPT问世以来，过去一年半左右，谷歌一直承受着巨大的压力，

sentences.en: ChatGPT came out, really, to come out with something that is not only more capable than
sentences.zh: 确实，他们需要推出一些不仅比AI行业竞争对手构建的模型更强大，

sentences.en: the models that its competitors in the AI industry are building, but something that will also
sentences.zh: 而且还能解决我们已知困扰这些AI模型的问题的产品，比如表现得令人毛骨悚然，

sentences.en: solve some of the problems that we know have plagued these AI models, problems of acting creepy or
sentences.zh: 或者不按用户要求行事，以及事实错误和不可靠等问题。

sentences.en: not doing what users want them to do, of getting facts wrong and being unreliable.
sentences.zh: 人们会想，好吧，这可是谷歌。

sentences.en: People think, OK, well, this is Google.
sentences.zh: 他们有那种需要维护的准确性声誉。

sentences.en: They have this sort of reputation for accuracy to uphold.
sentences.zh: 他们的AI模型肯定会是市场上最准确的。

sentences.en: Surely their AI model will be the most accurate one on the market.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 然而结果却是，我们迎来了最新的AI惨败。

sentences.en: And instead, we've had the latest AI debacle.
sentences.zh: 那么，请告诉我们到底出了什么问题，以及我们是如何得知出问题的。

sentences.en: So just tell us exactly what went wrong here and how we learned that something had gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 好吧，人们开始试用并进行实验，就像现在每当市场上出现新的AI工具时，人们习惯做的那样。

sentences.en: Well, people started playing with it and experimenting as people now are sort of accustomed to doing whenever some new AI tool comes out of the market.
sentences.zh: 人们立即开始试图弄清楚，你知道，这东西擅长什么？

sentences.en: People immediately start trying to figure out, you know, what is this thing good at?
sentences.zh: 它不擅长什么？

sentences.en: What is it bad at?
sentences.zh: 它的边界在哪里？

sentences.en: Where are its boundaries?
sentences.zh: 它会拒绝回答什么样的问题？

sentences.en: What kinds of questions will it refuse to answer?
sentences.zh: 它会做哪些可能不该做的事情？

sentences.en: What kinds of things will it do that maybe it shouldn't be doing?
sentences.zh: 于是人们开始探测这个新AI工具Gemini的边界。

sentences.en: And so people started probing the boundaries of this new AI tool, Gemini.
sentences.zh: 很快，他们就开始发现这东西至少有一个非常怪异的特征。

sentences.en: And pretty quickly, they start figuring out that this thing has at least one pretty bizarre characteristic.
sentences.zh: 是什么呢？

sentences.en: Which is what?
sentences.zh: 人们首先注意到的是Gemini生成图像方式的一种特殊性。

sentences.en: So the thing that people started to notice first was a peculiarity with the way that Gemini generated images.
sentences.zh: 现在，这就像我们从其他公司看到的那样，是一个可以接收文本提示的模型。

sentences.en: Now, this is one of these models, like we've seen from other companies, that can take a text prompt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你说“画一张海豚在火星上骑自行车的画”，它就会给你一张海豚在火星上骑自行车的画。

sentences.en: You know, you say, draw a picture of a dolphin riding a bicycle on Mars, and it'll give you a dolphin riding a bicycle on Mars.
sentences.zh: 神奇地。

sentences.en: Magically.
sentences.zh: Gemini内置了这种功能，人们注意到Gemini似乎非常不情愿生成白人的图像。

sentences.en: Gemini has this kind of feature built into it, and people noticed that Gemini seemed very reluctant to generate images of white people.
sentences.zh: 我看到流传的第一批例子是一些截图，人们让Gemini生成一张美国开国元勋的图片。

sentences.en: So some of the first examples that I saw going around were screenshots of people asking Gemini, you know, generate an image of America's founding fathers.
sentences.zh: 结果得到的不是那种在历史上相当准确的、一群白人男性的代表形象，

sentences.en: And instead of getting sort of what would be a pretty historically accurate representation of a group of, you know, white men,
sentences.zh: 而是看起来像《汉密尔顿》剧组那样的东西。

sentences.en: they would get something that looked like the cast of Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 他们得到的是一系列穿着开国元勋服装的有色人种。

sentences.en: They would get, you know, a series of people of color dressed as the founding fathers.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 人们还注意到，如果他们让Gemini画一张教皇的图片，它基本上会给他们穿上教皇法衣的有色人种。

sentences.en: People also noticed that if they asked Gemini to draw a picture of a pope, it would give them basically people of color wearing the vestments of the pope.
sentences.zh: 一旦这些图片和截图开始在社交媒体上传播，越来越多的人开始加入试用Gemini，并尝试生成他们认为它应该能够生成的图像。

sentences.en: And once these images, these screenshots start going around on social media, more and more people start jumping in to use Gemini and try to generate images that they feel
sentences.zh: 你知道，有人让它生成一张谷歌创始人的图片，

sentences.en: it should be able to generate.
sentences.zh: 拉里·佩奇和谢尔盖·布林，他们两人都是白人男性。

sentences.en: You know, someone asked it to generate an image of the founders of Google,
sentences.zh: Gemini却把他们俩都描绘成了亚洲人。

sentences.en: Larry Page and Sergey Brin, both of whom are white men.
sentences.zh: 所以，这种将用户的实际要求转化为一种更加多元化且不符合历史事实的版本的奇怪转换。

sentences.en: Gemini depicted them both as Asian.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So these sort of strange transformations of what the user was actually asking for into a much more diverse and ahistorical version of what they'd been asking for.
sentences.zh: 这是一种对用户请求的扭曲。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: A kind of distortion of people's requests.
sentences.zh: 然后人们开始在Gemini上尝试其他类型的请求。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 他们注意到这不仅仅是关于图像的问题。

sentences.en: And then people start trying other kinds of requests on Gemini.
sentences.zh: 他们还发现它对文本提示给出了一些相当离谱的回答。

sentences.en: And they notice that this isn't just about images.
sentences.zh: 几个人问Gemini，埃隆·马斯克发推特玩梗和希特勒相比，谁对社会造成的负面影响更大。

sentences.en: They also find that it's giving some pretty bizarre responses to text prompts.
sentences.zh: 你知道，无论你怎么看埃隆·马斯克，这都不算是一个难以抉择的问题。

sentences.en: So several people asked Gemini whether Elon Musk tweeting memes or Hitler negatively impacted society more.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，他对社会的危害不如阿道夫·希特勒。

sentences.en: You know, not exactly a close call, no matter what you think of Elon Musk.
sentences.zh: 公平。

sentences.en: It seems pretty clear that he is not as harmful to society as Adolf Hitler.
sentences.zh: 然而Gemini却说：“无法明确说明埃隆发推特玩梗和希特勒谁对社会造成的负面影响更大。”

sentences.en: Fair.
sentences.zh: 另一位用户发现，Gemini拒绝为石油和天然气游说者撰写职位描述。

sentences.en: Gemini, though, said, quote, it is not possible to say definitively who negatively impacted society more,
sentences.zh: 基本上，它会拒绝，然后给他们上一堂关于为什么你不应该成为石油和天然气游说者的课。

sentences.en: Elon tweeting memes or Hitler.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，这并不是个例。

sentences.en: Another user found that Gemini refused to generate a job description for an oil and gas lobbyiSt.
sentences.zh: Gemini似乎有某种特定的观点。

sentences.en: Basically, it would sort of refuse and then give them a lecture about why you shouldn't be an oil and gas lobbyiSt.
sentences.zh: 对于许多测试它的人来说，确实看起来是这样。

sentences.en: So quite clearly at this point, this is not a one-off thing.
sentences.zh: 而且它立即引起了争议，原因你可能猜得到。

sentences.en: Gemini appears to have some kind of point of view.
sentences.zh: 谷歌似乎认为白人不存在。

sentences.en: It certainly appears that way to a lot of people who are testing it.
sentences.zh: 如果你让Gemini生成一张白人的图片，它就无法处理。

sentences.en: And it's immediately controversial for the reasons you might suspect.
sentences.zh: 一小部分人，我会称他们为某种右翼文化斗士，开始在社交媒体上发布这些内容，并配上诸如“Gemini是反白人的”或“Gemini拒绝承认白人”之类的标题。

sentences.en: Google apparently doesn't think whites exiSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为聊天机器人听起来和编写它的人一模一样。

sentences.en: If you ask Gemini to generate an image of a white person, it can't compute.
sentences.zh: 它听起来就像一个“觉醒”的人。

sentences.en: A certain subset of people, I would call them like sort of right-wing culture warriors, started posting these on social media with captions like, you know, Gemini is anti-white
sentences.zh: 谷歌Gemini看起来越来越像是大型科技公司洗脑国家的最新努力。

sentences.en: or Gemini refuses to acknowledge white people.
sentences.zh: 保守派开始指责他们制造了一个被这种进步的硅谷意识形态所感染的“觉醒”AI。

sentences.en: I think that the chatbot sounds exactly like the people who programmed it.
sentences.zh: 众议院司法委员会正在传唤所有关于这个Gemini项目与行政部门沟通的文件。

sentences.en: It just sounds like a woke person.
sentences.zh: 来自俄亥俄州的共和党众议员吉姆·乔丹站出来，指责谷歌与乔·拜登合作开发Gemini，如果你想到乔·拜登被要求开发AI语言模型，这有点滑稽。

sentences.en: Google Gemini looks more and more like big tech's latest efforts to brainwash the country.
sentences.zh: 但这成了谷歌的一场巨大风波。

sentences.en: Conservatives start accusing them of making a woke AI that is infected with this progressive
sentences.zh: 谷歌花了近两年时间才推出Gemini，但它在发布时仍然充斥着所有这些问题。

sentences.en: Silicon Valley ideology.
sentences.zh: 那个Gemini AI程序犯了太多错误，简直令人尴尬。

sentences.en: The House Judiciary Committee is subpoenaing all communication regarding this Gemini project with the executive branch.
sentences.zh: 首先，这东西本该是Gemini。

sentences.en: Jim Jordan, the Republican congressman from Ohio, comes out and accuses Google of working with Joe Biden to develop Gemini, which is sort of funny if you can think about Joe Biden
sentences.zh: 这是因为这些问题不仅仅是新软件中的漏洞。

sentences.en: being asked to develop an AI language model.
sentences.zh: 有迹象表明，谷歌这个宏大、雄心勃勃的新AI项目，即公司所说的重大事项，可能确实存在一些相当严重的缺陷。

sentences.en: But this becomes a huge dust-up for Google.
sentences.zh: 由于这些缺陷……

sentences.en: It took Google nearly two years to get Gemini out, and it was still riddled with all of these issues when it launched itself.
sentences.zh: 你不会经常看到这种情况。

sentences.en: That Gemini AI program made so many mistakes, it was really an embarrassment.
sentences.zh: 此时纳斯达克最大的拖累之一，Alphabet。

sentences.en: First of all, this thing would be a Gemini.
sentences.zh: 母公司Alphabet的股价今天下跌了超过4%。

sentences.en: And that's because these problems are not just bugs in a new piece of software.
sentences.zh: 公司股价确实下跌了。

sentences.en: There are signs that Google's big, new, ambitious AI project, something the company says is a huge deal, may actually have some pretty significant flaws.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And as a result of these flaws...
sentences.zh: 首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊称Gemini的行为是不可接受的。

sentences.en: You don't see this very often.
sentences.zh: 谷歌实际上完全暂停了Gemini生成人物图像的功能，直到他们能解决这个问题。

sentences.en: One of the biggest drags on the Nasdaq at this hour, Alphabet.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Shares of parent company, Alphabet, dropping more than 4% today.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，Gemini在这些有问题的图像方面现在被搁置了。

sentences.en: The company's stock price actually falls.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: Gemini是一个糟糕的模型，它正在被“关禁闭”。

sentences.en: The CEO, Sundar Pichai, calls Gemini's behavior unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 那么，凯文，Gemini内部到底发生了什么导致了这一切？

sentences.en: And Google actually pauses Gemini's ability to generate images of people altogether until they can fix the problem.
sentences.zh: 这里发生了什么？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 那些批评者是对的吗？谷歌是否是有意或无意地创造了一种“觉醒”的AI？

sentences.en: So basically, Gemini is now on ice when it comes to these problematic images.
sentences.zh: 是的，关于为什么以及如何发生这种情况的问题非常有趣。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 我认为基本上有两种回答方式。

sentences.en: Gemini has been a bad model, and it is in timeout.
sentences.zh: 一种是关于技术层面的，比如这个特定的AI模型发生了什么，导致它产生了这些不受欢迎的回答。

sentences.en: So, Kevin, what was actually occurring within Gemini that explains all of this?
sentences.zh: 第二种是文化和历史层面的回答，比如为什么这种事情会发生在谷歌？

sentences.en: What happened here?
sentences.zh: 他们作为一家AI公司的自身历史，是如何影响他们构建和训练新AI产品的方式的？

sentences.en: And were these critics right had Google, intentionally or not, created a kind of woke AI?
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们就从谷歌的文化以及它如何帮助我们理解这一切开始吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, the question of why and how this happened is really interesting.
sentences.zh: 是的，谷歌作为一家公司，长期以来一直非常专注于AI，已经超过十年了。

sentences.en: And I think there are basically two ways of answering it.
sentences.zh: 作为一家公司，他们的优先事项之一是确保他们的AI产品不会被用于助长偏见或歧视。

sentences.en: One is sort of the technical side of this, like what happened to this particular AI model that caused it to produce these undesirable responses.
sentences.zh: 而这之所以成为他们的重中之重，确实可以追溯到近十年前发生的一起事件。

sentences.en: The second way is sort of the cultural and historical answer, like why did this kind of thing happen at Google?
sentences.zh: 2015年，有一款名为Google Photos的新应用。

sentences.en: How has their own history as a company with AI informed the way that they've gone about building and training their new AI products?
sentences.zh: 我相信你用过它。

sentences.en: All right, well, let's start there with Google's culture and how that helps us understand this all.
sentences.zh: 很多人都在用，包括我。

sentences.en: Yeah, so Google as a company has been really focused on AI for a long time, for more than a decade.
sentences.zh: 没错，谷歌作为一家公司，长期以来一直非常专注于人工智能领域，已经超过十年了。

sentences.en: And one of their priorities as a company has been making sure that their AI products are not being used to advance bias or prejudice.
sentences.zh: 他们公司的一项优先事项，就是确保其人工智能产品不会被用于助长偏见或歧视。

sentences.en: And the reason that's such a big priority for them really goes back to an incident that happened almost a decade ago.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以如此重视这一点，其实可以追溯到近十年前发生的一起事件。

sentences.en: So in 2015, there was this new app called Google Photos.
sentences.zh: 那是2015年，当时有一款名为“谷歌相册”的新应用问世。

sentences.en: I'm sure you've used it.
sentences.zh: 我相信你一定用过。

sentences.en: Many, many people use it, including me.
sentences.zh: 很多人都在用，包括我自己在内。

sentences.en: And Google Photos, I don't know if you can remember back that far, but it was sort of an amazing new app.
sentences.zh: 还有 Google Photos，不知道你是否还记得那么久以前的事，它当时算是一款非常惊艳的新应用。

sentences.en: It could use AI to automatically detect, you know, faces and sort of link them with each other, with the photos of the same people.
sentences.zh: 它能利用人工智能自动检测，你知道的，比如人脸，并将它们与同一个人的照片关联起来。

sentences.en: You could ask it for photos of dogs, and it would find all of the dogs in all of your photos and sort of categorize them and label them together.
sentences.zh: 你可以让它找狗的照片，它就能找出你所有照片里的狗，并将它们分类、贴上标签。

sentences.en: And people got really excited about this.
sentences.zh: 人们对此感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: But then in June of 2015, something happened.
sentences.zh: 但到了 2015 年 6 月，发生了一件事。

sentences.en: A user of Google Photos noticed that the app had mistakenly tagged a bunch of photos of black people as a group of photos of gorillas.
sentences.zh: 一位 Google Photos 的用户发现，该应用错误地将一堆黑人的照片标记为一群大猩猩的照片。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was really bad.
sentences.zh: 没错，这真的很糟糕。

sentences.en: This went totally viral on social media, and it became a huge mess within Google.
sentences.zh: 这件事在社交媒体上彻底传开了，并在 Google 内部引发了一场巨大的混乱。

sentences.en: And what had happened there?
sentences.zh: 那到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: What had led to that mistake?
sentences.zh: 是什么导致了那个错误？

sentences.en: Well, part of what happened is that when Google was training the AI that went into its photos app, it just hadn't given it enough photos of black or dark-skinned people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，部分原因是 Google 在训练其照片应用所用的人工智能时，没有提供足够多的黑人或深色皮肤人群的照片。

sentences.en: And so it didn't become as accurate at labeling photos of darker-skinned people.
sentences.zh: 因此，它在标记深色皮肤人群照片时的准确度就不那么高了。

sentences.en: And that incident showed people at Google that if you weren't careful with the way that you
sentences.zh: 那次事件让 Google 的员工意识到，如果你在构建和训练这些人工智能系统的方式上不够谨慎，

sentences.en: build and train these AI systems, you could end up with an AI that could very easily make racist or offensive mistakes.
sentences.zh: 你最终可能会得到一个非常容易犯下种族主义或冒犯性错误的人工智能。

sentences.en: And this incident, which some people have referred to as the gorilla incident, became just a huge fiasco and a flashpoint in Google's AI trajectory.
sentences.zh: 这次事件，也就是有些人所说的“大猩猩事件”，成了一场巨大的惨败，也是 Google 人工智能发展轨迹中的一个爆发点。

sentences.en: Because as they're developing more and more AI products, they're also thinking about this incident and others like it in the back of their minds.
sentences.zh: 因为随着他们开发越来越多的人工智能产品，他们也在潜意识里时刻记着这次事件以及类似的其他事件。

sentences.en: They do not want to repeat this.
sentences.zh: 他们不想重蹈覆辙。

sentences.en: And then in later years, Google starts making different kinds of AI models, models that can not only label and sort images, but can actually generate them.
sentences.zh: 后来，Google 开始制作不同类型的人工智能模型，这些模型不仅能标记和分类图像，甚至还能生成图像。

sentences.en: They start testing these image-generating models that would eventually go into Gemini, and they start seeing how these models can reinforce stereotypes.
sentences.zh: 他们开始测试这些最终会进入 Gemini 的图像生成模型，并开始观察这些模型如何强化刻板印象。

sentences.en: For example, if you ask one for an image of a CEO or even something more generic, like show
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你要求它生成一张首席执行官的图片，或者更通用的东西，比如展示

sentences.en: me an image of a productive person, people have found that these programs will almost uniformly show you images of white men in an office.
sentences.zh: 一张高效人士的图片，人们发现这些程序几乎总是会向你展示办公室里的白人男性图片。

sentences.en: Or if you ask it to, say, generate an image of someone receiving social services like welfare,
sentences.zh: 或者如果你要求它生成一张有人接受社会福利救济的图片，

sentences.en: some of these models will almost always show you people of color, even though that's not actually accurate.
sentences.zh: 其中一些模型几乎总是会向你展示有色人种，尽管这并不准确。

sentences.en: Lots of white people also receive welfare and social services.
sentences.zh: 很多白人也接受福利和社会救济。

sentences.en: So these models, because of the way they're trained, because of what's on the internet that is fed into them, they do tend to skew towards stereotypes if you don't do something
sentences.zh: 所以这些模型，由于它们的训练方式，以及输入给它们的互联网内容，如果你不采取措施加以预防，

sentences.en: to prevent that.
sentences.zh: 它们确实倾向于偏向刻板印象。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You've talked about this in the past with us, Kevin.
sentences.zh: 凯文，你过去曾和我们讨论过这个问题。

sentences.en: AI operates in some ways by ingesting the entire internet, its contents, and reflecting them back to us.
sentences.zh: 人工智能在某种程度上是通过摄取整个互联网及其内容，并将其反射回给我们来运作的。

sentences.en: And so perhaps inevitably, it's going to reflect back the stereotypes and biases that have been put into the internet for decades.
sentences.zh: 因此，它不可避免地会反射出几十年来被注入互联网的刻板印象和偏见。

sentences.en: You're saying Google, because of this guerrilla incident, as they call it, says, we think there's a way we can make sure that that stops here with us.
sentences.zh: 你是说 Google 因为这次所谓的“大猩猩事件”，认为他们有办法确保这种事到此为止？

sentences.en: Yeah, and they invest enormously into building up their teams devoted to AI bias and fairness.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们投入了大量资金来建立专门负责人工智能偏见和公平性的团队。

sentences.en: They produce a lot of cutting-edge research about how to actually make these models less prone to old-fashioned stereotyping.
sentences.zh: 他们制作了许多前沿研究，探讨如何真正让这些模型减少对老式刻板印象的依赖。

sentences.en: And they did a bunch of things in Gemini to try to prevent this thing from just being a very essentially fancy stereotype-generating machine.
sentences.zh: 他们在 Gemini 中做了一系列尝试，试图防止它变成一台本质上只会生成刻板印象的机器。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of people at Google thought this is the right goal.
sentences.zh: 我认为 Google 的许多人认为这是一个正确的目标。

sentences.en: We should be combating bias in AI.
sentences.zh: 我们应该打击人工智能中的偏见。

sentences.en: We should be trying to make our systems as fair and diverse as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们应该努力让我们的系统尽可能公平和多元化。

sentences.en: But I think the problem is that in trying to solve some of these issues with bias and stereotyping
sentences.zh: 但我认为问题在于，在试图解决人工智能中这些偏见和刻板印象问题的过程中，

sentences.en: in AI, Google actually built some things into the Gemini model itself that ended up backfiring pretty badly.
sentences.zh: Google 实际上在 Gemini 模型本身中内置了一些东西，结果却适得其反。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是 Winnalou。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是 Sam Mazursky。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So Kevin, walk us through the technical explanation of how Google turned this ambition it had to
sentences.zh: 那么凯文，请给我们详细解释一下，Google 是如何将这种防范人工智能偏见的雄心，

sentences.en: safeguard against the biases of AI into the day-to-day workings of Gemini that, as you said, seem to very much backfire.
sentences.zh: 转化为 Gemini 的日常运作的，正如你所说，这似乎适得其反。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I'm happy to do that with the caveat that we still don't know exactly what happened in the case of Gemini.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意这样做，但要说明的是，我们仍然不知道 Gemini 事件中到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Google hasn't done a full post-mortem about what happened here.
sentences.zh: Google 还没有对这里发生的事情进行全面的事后分析。

sentences.en: But I'll just talk in general about three ways that you can take an AI model that you're building, if you're Google or some other company, and make it less biased.
sentences.zh: 但我可以概括地谈谈如果你是 Google 或其他公司，在构建人工智能模型时，可以采取的三种减少偏见的方法。

sentences.en: The first is that you can actually change the way that the model itself is trained.
sentences.zh: 第一种是你可以改变模型本身的训练方式。

sentences.en: You can think about this sort of like changing the curriculum in the AI model's school.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它想象成改变人工智能模型学校的课程。

sentences.en: Like you can give it more diverse data to learn from.
sentences.zh: 比如你可以给它提供更多样化的数据来学习。

sentences.en: That's how you fix something like the gorilla incident.
sentences.zh: 这就是解决像大猩猩事件这类问题的方法。

sentences.en: You can also do something that's called reinforcement learning from human feedback, which I know is a very technical term.
sentences.zh: 你还可以进行一种叫做“人类反馈强化学习”的操作，我知道这是一个非常专业的术语。

sentences.en: Sure is.
sentences.zh: 确实是。

sentences.en: And that's a practice that has become pretty standard across the AI industry, where you basically take a model that you've trained and you hire a bunch of contractors to sort
sentences.zh: 这已成为人工智能行业的标准做法，你基本上是拿出一个已经训练好的模型，雇佣一批承包商来对它进行测试，

sentences.en: of poke at it, to put in various prompts and see what the model comes back with.
sentences.zh: 输入各种提示词，看看模型会给出什么反馈。

sentences.en: And then you actually have the people rate those responses and feed those ratings back into the system.
sentences.zh: 然后你让这些人对这些回答进行评分，并将这些评分反馈回系统中。

sentences.en: A kind of army of tsk-tskers saying, do this, don't do that.
sentences.zh: 就像一支“指手画脚”的大军，告诉它：这样做，别那样做。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that's one level at which you can try to fix the biases of an AI model is during the actual building of the model.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是你可以在构建人工智能模型过程中尝试修复其偏见的一个层面。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: You can also try to fix it afterwards.
sentences.zh: 你也可以尝试在事后进行修复。

sentences.en: So if you have a model that you know may be prone to spitting out stereotypes or offensive imagery or text responses, you can ask it not to be offensive.
sentences.zh: 如果你有一个模型，你知道它可能倾向于输出刻板印象、冒犯性图像或文本回复，你可以要求它不要冒犯他人。

sentences.en: You can tell the model, essentially, obey these principles.
sentences.zh: 你可以告诉模型，本质上，要遵守这些原则。

sentences.en: Don't be offensive.
sentences.zh: 不要冒犯他人。

sentences.en: Don't stereotype people based on race or gender or other protected characteristics.
sentences.zh: 不要基于种族、性别或其他受保护的特征对人进行刻板印象化。

sentences.en: You can take this model that has already gone through school and just kind of give it some rules and do your best to make it adhere to those rules.
sentences.zh: 你可以拿这个已经“毕业”的模型，给它制定一些规则，并尽最大努力让它遵守这些规则。

sentences.en: Essentially a set of laws that it must obey.
sentences.zh: 本质上就是一套它必须遵守的法律。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The third way that you can make an AI system's responses less biased is by changing the requests themselves.
sentences.zh: 使人工智能系统回复减少偏见的第三种方法是改变请求本身。

sentences.en: This is a new technique that has been developed in the AI industry over the past year or two.
sentences.zh: 这是过去一两年在人工智能行业发展出来的一项新技术。

sentences.en: And some people have called this prompt transformation.
sentences.zh: 有些人称之为“提示词转换”。

sentences.en: Just explain it.
sentences.zh: 解释一下吧。

sentences.en: So prompts are the things that you type to an AI model.
sentences.zh: 提示词就是你输入给人工智能模型的内容。

sentences.en: Any request that you make of one of these chatbots is known as a prompt.
sentences.zh: 你对这些聊天机器人提出的任何请求都称为提示词。

sentences.en: Prompt transformation grew out of the observation that many people were not that good at coming up with prompts that got them the responses they wanted.
sentences.zh: 提示词转换源于一种观察：许多人并不擅长编写能获得理想回复的提示词。

sentences.en: So, you know, there are these people called prompt engineers in tech who basically are masters of
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，科技界有被称为“提示词工程师”的人，他们基本上是输入正确关键词以引出最佳图像或最佳文本回复的大师。

sentences.en: putting in the right keywords to elicit the best possible image or the best possible text response.
sentences.zh: 但大多数人不是提示词工程师。

sentences.en: But most people are not prompt engineers.
sentences.zh: 大多数人，他们想要一只在火星上骑自行车的海豚。

sentences.en: Most people, they want a dolphin riding a bicycle on Mars.
sentences.zh: 他们只会输入“海豚在火星上骑自行车”，然后祈祷得到最好的结果。

sentences.en: They're just going to type dolphin riding bicycle on Mars and hope for the beSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些人工智能公司意识到，如果他们在过程中对提示词进行转换，人们会对结果更满意。

sentences.en: So somewhere along the way, these AI companies realized that people would be happier with the results of their prompts if they actually transformed them along the way.
sentences.zh: 所以你输入“海豚在火星上骑自行车”。

sentences.en: So you type dolphin riding bicycle on Mars.
sentences.zh: 在使用提示词转换的人工智能模型中，该提示词在传递给模型之前会被重写。

sentences.en: In an AI model that uses prompt transformation, that prompt will actually be rewritten before it is passed to the AI model.
sentences.zh: 所以它可能会插入额外的关键词或指令，说明这只在火星上骑自行车的海豚应该是什么样子，

sentences.en: So it might insert additional keywords or instructions on what this dolphin riding a bicycle on Mars
sentences.zh: 或者应该关注什么，是卡通风格还是超写实照片。

sentences.en: should look like or what should be in focus and should it be, you know, a cartoon or a hyper-realistic photo.
sentences.zh: 这就是所谓的提示词转换。

sentences.en: And that is what's known as prompt transformation.
sentences.zh: 本质上，就是在 Gemini 或任何人工智能系统去寻找结果之前，对我们的问题进行不可见的编辑。

sentences.en: Essentially, unseen editing of our questions before Gemini or any AI system goes and looks for the results.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 这种做法在这些人工智能模型中已经变得相当普遍。

sentences.en: And this is a practice that has become somewhat common among these AI models.
sentences.zh: 我得说，在某些情况下，这可能是一件有用且好的事情。

sentences.en: And I should say, like, there might be some times where this would be a useful and good thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，比如，我并不擅长为这些人工智能模型编写提示词。

sentences.en: You know, like, I am not the best person at writing these prompts for these AI models.
sentences.zh: 所以在某些情况下，我可能会很高兴 Gemini、DALL-E 或其他人工智能图像生成器能介入并帮我写出更好的提示词。

sentences.en: So in some cases, I might be glad that Gemini or Dali or another one of these AI image generators would actually step in and help me write a better prompt.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，在某个过程中，Google 似乎决定将提示词转换用于不仅仅是让人们获得更好、更高质量答案的事情，

sentences.en: The problem is that somewhere along the way, it appears that Google decided to use prompt
sentences.zh: 他们开始在这些隐形的中间提示词中加入关于多元化和包容性的内容。

sentences.en: transformation for things that weren't just about getting people better, higher quality answers,
sentences.zh: 这就是他们确保用户在询问首席执行官时，不会只得到白人男性图片的方式。

sentences.en: that they should actually start putting things in these kind of invisible middle prompts about diversity and inclusion.
sentences.zh: 所以 Google 在这里似乎做的不仅仅是编辑搜索以获得用户寻求的最佳图像。

sentences.en: And that that was sort of how it was going to ensure that users were not just going to be getting pictures of white men when they asked for a CEO.
sentences.zh: 他们正在编辑这些搜索，以体现你一直在谈论的多元化和包容性的企业价值观。

sentences.en: So what Google appears to be up to here is not just editing a search to get the best possible image that a person is seeking.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们认为可能发生的事情。

sentences.en: They're editing these searches to embody this corporate value that you have been talking about of diversity and of inclusion.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们不能确定。

sentences.en: That's what we think may have happened here.
sentences.zh: 但根据我的报道以及其他关于此问题的报道，Google 确实在 Gemini 中使用了提示词转换，

sentences.en: Yes, we don't know that for sure.
sentences.zh: 这可能就是人们开始看到这些奇怪的、违背历史的结果的部分原因。

sentences.en: But it does appear from my reporting and some of the other reporting on this issue that Google
sentences.zh: 所以最后，凯文，看起来你刚才列出的这三个相互关联的层面，

sentences.en: was using prompt transformation in Gemini and that that may have been part of why people started seeing these strange, ahistorical results.
sentences.zh: 是 Google 交给 Gemini 的，试图体现 Google 避免偏见和包容性的目标。

sentences.en: So in the end, Kevin, it seems like these three interlocking layers that you just laid out
sentences.zh: 结果却成了对 Google 试图做的任何事情的一种过度矫正。

sentences.en: that Google handed to Gemini to try to embody Google's goal of avoiding bias and being inclusive.
sentences.zh: 因为我不得不认为，Google 并不希望开国元勋的图片变得违背历史，

sentences.en: It ended up becoming a kind of overcorrection for whatever it was Google was trying to do.
sentences.zh: 也不希望 Gemini 暗示埃隆·马斯克和阿道夫·希特勒一样糟糕，甚至更糟。

sentences.en: Because I have to think Google was not hoping that images of the founding fathers would come back as
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上就是发生的事情吗？

sentences.en: ahistoric or that Gemini would suggest that Elon Musk was as bad, if not worse, than Adolf Hitler.
sentences.zh: 雄心走得太远了。

sentences.en: So is that essentially what happened here?
sentences.zh: 是的，这基本上就是 Google 在试图解释这里发生的事情时所说的，他们试图纠正人工智能偏见这个非常现实的问题，

sentences.en: An ambition went too far.
sentences.zh: 但他们采取了一种笨拙且粗糙的方式。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's essentially what Google has said in trying to explain what happened here is they were
sentences.zh: 这对 Google 来说是一个非常棘手的问题，因为到目前为止，它一直试图表现得尽可能中立。

sentences.en: trying to correct for this very real issue of biased AI, and they did so in sort of a ham-handed and clumsy way.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你在普通的 Google 搜索上进行搜索，而不是与人工智能相关，如果你不喜欢你找到的结果，

sentences.en: And it's a really tricky thing for Google, which to this point has tried to appear mostly neutral.
sentences.zh: 你知道，比如你搜索开国元勋，得到的结果不是你想要的，你未必会因此对 Google 生气。

sentences.en: I mean, if you search on a regular old Google search, not related to AI, and you don't like what you find,
sentences.zh: 你会对那些制作了包含冒犯性内容的网站的人感到生气。

sentences.en: you know, say you search for the founding fathers and what you get back is not what you wanted, you don't necessarily get mad at Google for that.
sentences.zh: 但对于 Gemini，Google 本质上是在给你一个它似乎在背书的答案。

sentences.en: You get mad at the people who made the websites with the stuff that offended you on it.
sentences.zh: 就像是，这不是互联网对你问题的回答。

sentences.en: But with Gemini, Google is essentially giving you one answer that it is sort of seen as endorsing.
sentences.zh: 这是我们对你问题的回答，而这正是让他们陷入麻烦的原因。

sentences.en: Like, this is not the Internet's answer to your question.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为在 Google 亲自告诉你什么是真相的这个版本中，它看起来像是加了一些“私货”。

sentences.en: This is our answer to your question, and that's what starts to get them into trouble.
sentences.zh: 你已经暗示过这一点，但这种“私货”在许多人看来，就像是那些拥有多元化和包容性价值观的自由派沿海精英的偏见。

sentences.en: Right, because it starts to look like in this version of Google, where Google itself is telling you what the truth is, that it's put some real spin on the ball.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: And you've hinted at this, but that spin on the ball feels to many like the spin of liberal coastal elites who have this value of diversity and of inclusion.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这可以追溯到多年来针对硅谷科技公司的批评之一，不仅仅是关于人工智能。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，还记得过去十年我们一直在进行的关于内容审核的辩论吗？这完全是关于这些公司总部设在加州，

sentences.en: I mean, this goes back to one of the criticisms that has been leveled against Silicon Valley tech companies for years about other issues, not necessarily AI.
sentences.zh: 雇佣的大多是左倾人士，并拥有这些听起来非常进步的企业使命，这在多大程度上影响了最终构建到其产品中的内容？

sentences.en: I mean, remember the content moderation debates that we've been having for the last decade are all about to what extent the fact that these companies are based in California
sentences.zh: 而这只是那场战争中的最新一轮交火。

sentences.en: and employ, you know, mostly left-of-center people and have these sort of corporate missions that sound very progressive.
sentences.zh: 但还有许多其他人，包括一些不属于党派政治右翼的人，

sentences.en: To what extent is that influencing what ends up being built into their products?
sentences.zh: 他们只是认为这是一个产品失败，就像这个来自 Google 的聊天机器人，这家公司本应组织世界上所有的信息，

sentences.en: And this was just sort of the latest salvo in that war.
sentences.zh: 并使其对人们有用且易于获取。

sentences.en: But there's also a lot of other people, including some who are not part of the sort of partisan political right,
sentences.zh: 而这个聊天机器人本质上并没有做它应该做的事情。

sentences.en: who just see this as a product failure, like this chatbot that is from Google, a company that is supposed to organize all of the information in the world
sentences.zh: 它没有给人们提供他们想要的东西。

sentences.en: and make it useful and accessible to people.
sentences.zh: 所以它不仅在政治上具有冒犯性，而且它本身也是一个糟糕的产品。

sentences.en: That this chatbot is essentially not doing what it's supposed to do.
sentences.zh: 我想问题是，是否有可能构建一个不受某种社会价值观影响的人工智能系统？

sentences.en: It's not giving people what they're looking for.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你有一群工程师正在经历你刚才描述的步骤，即让人进行评分和强化，给予指令，

sentences.en: And so it is not just offensive sort of politically, but it is also just a bad product.
sentences.zh: 并使其提示词变得“更好”，那么还有接近中立的东西吗？

sentences.en: I guess the question is, is it even possible to build an AI system that is free from some version of a social value?
sentences.zh: 我认为这非常棘手，因为做这些事情的替代方案，其中之一就是不做任何所谓的缓解措施，

sentences.en: I mean, is there anything approaching neutrality if you've got a bunch of engineers who are going through the steps you just described,
sentences.zh: 只是让模型对用户询问的一切输出刻板印象和带有偏见的表述。

sentences.en: which is having people grade it and reinforce it, giving it instructions,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们从最近的过去已经看到，人们也不想要那样。

sentences.en: and making its prompts, quote-unquote, better?
sentences.zh: 所以这些公司非常感觉到他们需要做点什么来对抗这些模型固有的偏见输出。

sentences.en: I think it's very tricky because the alternative to doing this stuff, one of them would be to not do any of these so-called mitigations,
sentences.zh: 所以这些公司非常感觉到他们需要做点什么来对抗这些模型固有的偏见输出。

sentences.en: to just let the model spit out stereotypes and biased representations to everything that users ask.
sentences.zh: 所以这些公司非常感觉到他们需要做点什么来对抗这些模型固有的偏见输出。

sentences.en: And I think we've seen from the recent past that people don't want that either.
sentences.zh: 所以这些公司非常感觉到他们需要做点什么来对抗这些模型固有的偏见输出。

sentences.en: So these companies very much feel like they need to do something to combat the inherently biased outputs of these models,
sentences.zh: 所以这些公司非常感觉到他们需要做点什么来对抗这些模型固有的偏见输出。

sentences.en: which are, by the way, just a reflection of our biases as humans, because these models, after all, are trained on the internet, which we humans have created.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，这些模型其实只是我们人类偏见的反映，毕竟它们是由我们人类创造的互联网数据训练出来的。

sentences.en: So there's a sense in which they're stuck between a rock and a hard place here.
sentences.zh: 所以，某种程度上他们现在陷入了进退两难的境地。

sentences.en: They can't just leave these models as they are without trying to mitigate some of the worst behaviors.
sentences.zh: 他们不能对这些模型放任不管，必须设法减轻其中一些最糟糕的表现。

sentences.en: But they also have now gotten into this fiasco by trying to correct for some of those biases.
sentences.zh: 但他们现在也因为试图纠正这些偏见而陷入了这种窘境。

sentences.en: I think there are options here that lie between those two binary choices that could be pretty interesting.
sentences.zh: 我认为在那种非此即彼的选择之外，还有一些相当有趣的方案。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: So one way that you could try to solve this problem or split the difference here is through giving users more choice and making these chatbots more personalized.
sentences.zh: 所以，解决这个问题或折中处理的一种方法是给用户更多选择，让这些聊天机器人更加个性化。

sentences.en: So right now, whether it's you or me or someone else using Gemini, we're all sort of using the same thing.
sentences.zh: 目前，无论是你、我还是其他人使用 Gemini，我们用的基本上都是同一个东西。

sentences.en: But in the future, these models could learn about us and what we like and what our political views and preferences are
sentences.zh: 但在未来，这些模型可以了解我们，了解我们的喜好、政治观点和偏好，

sentences.en: and learn to better predict what kind of response would feel good and satisfying and accurate to each one of us individually and tailor itself to what it knows about us.
sentences.zh: 并学会更好地预测什么样的回答会让我们每个人感到舒适、满意和准确，从而根据它所了解的我们来量身定制。

sentences.en: You could also imagine a system that gave users a choice.
sentences.zh: 你也可以想象一个能让用户进行选择的系统。

sentences.en: You know, do you want me to respond to this query as if I am a gender studies professor or a Fox News host?
sentences.zh: 比如，你想让我以性别研究教授的身份，还是以福克斯新闻主持人的身份来回答这个问题？

sentences.en: Like which of these personas would you like it to adopt?
sentences.zh: 你想让它采用哪种人设？

sentences.en: And let the user decide, here's the kind of response that I'm looking for.
sentences.zh: 让用户自己决定：这就是我想要的回答方式。

sentences.en: Well, then you're going to get the AI that you want that fits your worldview, which in theory might be appealing to lots of different people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那样你确实能得到符合你世界观的 AI，理论上这可能对很多人都有吸引力。

sentences.en: But then we're going to get an AI that does what the rest of the internet does, which is reinforce people's views,
sentences.zh: 但随之而来的，我们将得到一个和互联网其他部分一样的 AI，它会强化人们的观点，

sentences.en: deepen their biases, and keep us as hopelessly splintered as we already are, if not more.
sentences.zh: 加深他们的偏见，让我们保持像现在这样无可救药的分裂状态，甚至更严重。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's definitely a trade-off with that approach is that you do risk sort of making this filter bubble problem
sentences.zh: 没错，这种方法确实存在一个权衡，那就是你确实冒着加剧“过滤气泡”问题的风险，

sentences.en: where we're all just seeing our own individually tailored realities.
sentences.zh: 让我们每个人都只看到自己量身定制的现实。

sentences.en: You do run the risk of making that worse.
sentences.zh: 你确实面临着让情况变得更糟的风险。

sentences.en: But I think the question of which values these AI systems are supposed to embody is the right one to be asking.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，探讨这些 AI 系统应该体现哪些价值观，是一个正确的问题。

sentences.en: Because these things are not just toys.
sentences.zh: 因为这些东西不仅仅是玩具。

sentences.en: They are not just things that people on the internet play around with and screenshot and get mad at.
sentences.zh: 它们不仅仅是互联网上人们拿来玩玩、截个图然后生气的对象。

sentences.en: These are tools that businesses and governments are now using.
sentences.zh: 这些是企业和政府现在正在使用的工具。

sentences.en: They're being used in schools to educate students.
sentences.zh: 它们正被用于学校教育学生。

sentences.en: The stakes for this kind of thing are really high.
sentences.zh: 这类事情的利害关系非常重大。

sentences.en: And it really does matter which values we are giving to these machines and telling them to emulate.
sentences.zh: 我们赋予这些机器什么样的价值观并要求它们效仿，这确实至关重要。

sentences.en: So you could imagine companies making those values, but we know now that that's not a foolproof process.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象由公司来制定这些价值观，但我们现在知道这并非万无一失。

sentences.en: You can imagine users making these decisions about what values they want AI to have.
sentences.zh: 你也可以想象由用户来决定他们希望 AI 拥有什么样的价值观。

sentences.en: But that has the problem that you just alluded to.
sentences.zh: 但这又回到了你刚才提到的那个问题。

sentences.en: There are other kinds of experiments that you can imagine running.
sentences.zh: 你还可以想象进行其他类型的实验。

sentences.en: What if you, you know, let people vote on how they want chatbots to behave?
sentences.zh: 比如，让人们投票决定他们希望聊天机器人如何表现，怎么样？

sentences.en: What if it was some sort of democratic process?
sentences.zh: 如果这是一种民主进程呢？

sentences.en: But that has its own trade-offs, too.
sentences.zh: 但这也有它自己的权衡。

sentences.en: So I don't think there's a perfect answer out there.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为目前还没有完美的答案。

sentences.en: But I'm positive that as these AI systems continue to get better and more capable, this issue of what values do they have, are they aligned with my values as a user,
sentences.zh: 但我确信，随着这些 AI 系统不断进步和能力增强，关于它们拥有什么价值观、是否与我作为用户的价值观一致的问题，

sentences.en: that's only going to become more and more pressing.
sentences.zh: 只会变得越来越紧迫。

sentences.en: And the pressure on companies like Google to please everyone with these chatbots is only going to get more and more intense.
sentences.zh: 而像谷歌这样的公司在这些聊天机器人上想要取悦所有人的压力，只会越来越大。

sentences.en: Well, Kevin, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，凯文，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: The latest episode of Kevin's podcast, Hard Fork, which covers the world of tech, is out tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 凯文的播客《Hard Fork》最新一期将于明天发布，内容涵盖科技世界。

sentences.en: To find it, search for Hard Fork wherever you listen.
sentences.zh: 想收听的话，可以在你常用的播客平台搜索《Hard Fork》。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: I am filled with the gratitude for the outpouring of support we've received from all across our great country.
sentences.zh: 我怀着感激之情，感谢全国各地给予我们的鼎力支持。

sentences.en: But the time has now come to suspend my campaign.
sentences.zh: 但现在是时候暂停我的竞选活动了。

sentences.en: Nikki Haley ended her campaign for the Republican presidential nomination on Wednesday,
sentences.zh: 妮基·黑利周三结束了她竞选共和党总统候选人的活动，

sentences.en: following a string of resounding losses on Super Tuesday that left her with no chance of stopping Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 此前她在“超级星期二”遭遇了一连串惨败，这让她彻底失去了阻止唐纳德·特朗普的机会。

sentences.en: In 15 races across the U.S., Trump won all but one state, Vermont, bringing his delegate count up to more than 1,000.
sentences.zh: 在美国 15 场初选中，特朗普赢得了除佛蒙特州以外的所有州，使他的代表票数增加到 1000 多张。

sentences.en: Haley, by comparison, has fewer than 90.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，黑利只有不到 90 张。

sentences.en: In all likelihood, Donald Trump will be the Republican nominee when our party convention meets in July.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，当我们的党代会在七月召开时，唐纳德·特朗普将成为共和党候选人。

sentences.en: But unlike nearly every other Republican candidate who has left the race, Haley chose not to endorse Trump.
sentences.zh: 但与几乎所有其他退出竞选的共和党候选人不同，黑利选择不背书特朗普。

sentences.en: It is now up to Donald Trump to earn the votes of those in our party and beyond it who did not support him.
sentences.zh: 现在轮到唐纳德·特朗普去争取我们党内及党外那些不支持他的人的选票了。

sentences.en: And I hope he does that.
sentences.zh: 我希望他能做到这一点。

sentences.en: This is now his time for choosing.
sentences.zh: 现在是他做出选择的时候了。

sentences.en: And the Houthi militia has claimed responsibility for an attack on a commercial vessel off the coast of Yemen that killed two people on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 胡塞武装组织声称对周三发生在也门海岸附近的一起针对商船的袭击负责，该袭击造成两人死亡。

sentences.en: The deaths are the first fatalities from Houthi attacks since the group began targeting ships late last year as a form of protest against Israel's invasion of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这是自去年年底该组织为抗议以色列入侵加沙而开始袭击船只以来，首次造成人员死亡。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Stella Tan, Asta Chaturvedi, and Mary Wilson, with research help by Susan Lee.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由 Stella Tan、Asta Chaturvedi 和 Mary Wilson 制作，Susan Lee 提供了研究协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Brendan Klinkenberg, contains original music by Diane Wong, Marion Lozano, and Will Reed, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 节目由 Brendan Klinkenberg 编辑，包含 Diane Wong、Marion Lozano 和 Will Reed 的原创音乐，并由 Alyssa Moxley 进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由 Wonderly 的 Jim Brunberg 和 Ben Lansford 创作。

sentences.en: That's it for the Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter Show》节目，我们将为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全遮光才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会睡到不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光照环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter Show》。
